description: A comprehensive checklist matrix detailing features across Free, Team, and Enterprise deployment tiers.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Product Feature Matrix Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
